title: VoiceMailContent - Data API
description: Represents a voicemail message left by a caller to the context user.

DurationInSeconds.description: The duration of the voicemail message in seconds.

FirstHeardDateTime.description: The time and date when the user first listened to the voicemail message.

MediaContentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MediaContentId.description: The ID of the related media content, a ContentDocument. The record counts toward your org’s file storage quota.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the voicemail message.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of the voicemail message.

VoiceCallId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
VoiceCallId.description: The ID of the related Dialer call.

special_access_rules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **VoiceMailContentOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **VoiceMailContentShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
